يفتليا (form VIII)
# يَفْتَلِيَا (yaftaliyā) /jaf.ta.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
# يُفْتَلَيَا (yuftalayā) /juf.ta.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
